result.description: A fictional 27-inch studio display designed for color work, writing, and quiet desktop environments. It features a 2560 x 1440 OLED panel, 240 Hz refresh rate, USB-C display input with 90W power delivery, dual HDMI 2.1 ports, and an integrated ambient light sensor for automatic brightness adjustment. The monitor is positioned as a premium creative workstation screen rather than a storage device or game drive, with factory-calibrated sRGB and DCI-P3 modes, a matte anti-reflective coating, and height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustment. Includes an adjustable monitor hood and a 3-year limited warranty.
